items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: I remember the Warrant Officer, who was in charge of the band, subsequently went on and became Colonel Gabriel

ctx.x: Fairly soon after you write it.

It’s like having a baby. When I was in the service I’d just finished writing or copying an arrangement when I had come down the next morning we’d have jazz band and I’d put it down, let’s do it. You know what I’m saying? I did a lot of writing in the service. I remember the Warrant Officer, who was in charge of the band, subsequently went on and became Colonel Gabriel, the head of all the Air Force bands in Washington, after I left he went down to Washington. As I was getting out of the service he tried to stop…
It must have been pretty good then.
